name: cockroachdb
description: Connect Claude Code directly to your CockroachDB clusters for hands-on database work — explore schemas, write optimized SQL, debug queries, and manage distributed database clusters. This plugin provides tools across MCP backends (self-hosted MCP Toolbox and managed CockroachDB Cloud MCP Server), specialized agents (DBA, Developer, Operator), skills across operational domains, and built-in safety hooks.

hooks.command: python3 -c 'import os, runpy; r = r"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; r = r if r and not r.startswith("$") else os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT", ""); p = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(r, "scripts", "validate-sql.py")) if r else ""; p = chr(92) * 2 + "?" + chr(92) + p if p and os.name == "nt" else p; p and os.path.isfile(p) and runpy.run_path(p, run_name="__main__")'; exit 0

python3 -c 'import os, runpy; r = r"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; r = r if r and not r.startswith("$") else os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT", ""); p = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(r, "scripts", "check-sql-files.py")) if r else ""; p = chr(92) * 2 + "?" + chr(92) + p if p and os.name == "nt" else p; p and os.path.isfile(p) and runpy.run_path(p, run_name="__main__")'; exit 0
